scripts.compile: mkdir -p build keys proofs && circom circuits/f_source.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build
scripts.powersoftau:contribute: snarkjs powersoftau contribute keys/pot12_0000.ptau keys/pot12_0001.ptau --name='first contribution' -v
scripts.powersoftau:prepare: snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 keys/pot12_0001.ptau keys/pot12_final.ptau -v
scripts.groth16:setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/f_source.r1cs keys/pot12_final.ptau keys/f_source_0000.zkey
scripts.groth16:contribute: snarkjs zkey contribute keys/f_source_0000.zkey keys/f_source_final.zkey --name='f_source contribution' -v
scripts.verification-key: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey keys/f_source_final.zkey keys/verification_key.json
scripts.prove: snarkjs groth16 prove keys/f_source_final.zkey build/witness.wtns proofs/proof.json proofs/public.json
scripts.verify: snarkjs groth16 verify keys/verification_key.json proofs/public.json proofs/proof.json
scripts.full: npm run compile && npm run witness && npm run powersoftau:start && npm run powersoftau:contribute && npm run powersoftau:prepare && npm run groth16:setup && npm run groth16:contribute && npm run verification-key && npm run prove && npm run verify
